The Monetary and Banking Council of the Bank of Algeria authorised Djezzy Payment Services to constitute itself as a payment service provider under regulation 25-02, with a licence application due within twelve months.

Banking consultant Mostefa Zerouali says Bank of Algeria Regulation 25-02 sets the conditions for licensing payment service providers, that the Bank of Algeria is the licensing authority, and that none is yet licensed with several applications under examination.
